scope: Additive secondary-source activation-class correction for permanent Monolith Arrow L1-27; retain official housing tiers and leave projectile combat partial.
game_version: Monolith Arrow was introduced in the June 2026 Anime Fury release. The explicit Passive labels come from dated and current secondary coverage; exact September 2026 client build and attack effect ordering are unverified.

sources.title: THE ANIME FURY UPDATE IS HERE
sources.version: June 2026 Home Village update; client build not stated
facts: The release note identifies Monolith Arrow as Archer Queen Epic Equipment and publishes 14/10/5 percent target-max-HP tiers by deployed housing.
sources.limitations: It calls the effect an Ability but does not explicitly say Active or Passive, or define the attack and projectile tick order.

sources.title: Anime Fury Event
sources.version: June 2026 launch coverage; client build not published
facts: The dated article explicitly calls Monolith Arrow passive Equipment and describes Queen attacks dealing target-HP-based extra damage, reduced after deployed housing thresholds.
sources.limitations: It is a secondary account and does not define per-level percentage continuity, projectile timing, target classes, rounding or damage-reduction recipient. Its separate temporary June level boost is outside scope.

sources.title: What is Hero Equipment?
sources.version: Guide page read 2026-09-23; last update date and client build unpublished
facts: The guide table labels Monolith Arrow Passive and Epic, separately from Queen Active Equipment such as Giant Arrow.
sources.limitations: This is the same publisher as the dated launch article, not an independent primary classification or a combat event contract.

equipment_activation_type.note: Explicit dated secondary Passive label, repeated in the publisher's Equipment guide; primary release confirms identity but does not label activation. No projectile rule inferred.

derivations.method: Transcribe the dated source's explicit Passive label and cross-check its current guide table; retain the primary note's silence on classification and do not transfer temporary event boosts.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the official word Ability alone as a Passive label
rejected_inferences.reason: The primary note does not specify activation class; the override relies on a separate explicit secondary label.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply extra max-HP damage on the Queen's normal attack launch tick
rejected_inferences.reason: Passive describes input requirements, not projectile launch, impact, mitigation or rounding phase.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the June 11-16 temporary max-level event boost in ordinary battles
rejected_inferences.reason: The boost was time-limited event content and is excluded from the permanent TH18 simulator.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the new class evidence as proof of per-level current damage or Queen damage reduction
rejected_inferences.reason: The checked source classification does not define current numeric effect values or mitigation recipient.

items: primary-source or build-pinned confirmation of Passive class
normal-attack link and bonus projectile launch/impact tick order
housing sample phase and queued deployments
per-level current target-max-HP damage, caps and rounding
Queen damage-reduction meaning, stage and level mapping
other Equipment, Pet, spell, snapshot, replay and Viewer effect interactions

conclusion: Monolith Arrow is classified as Passive in the immutable catalogue with explicit dated secondary provenance. No damage or projectile actor is enabled; the combat contract and primary classification confirmation remain partial.
